text:
rachel: quick ping 9: planned staging rollout 01:45 UTC touching API header-splitting, runtime kernel change, router parity tweak, and console routing rules. proposing runtime pin for the window + deploy hold until prewarm + short canary.
tom: +1 to pin. last dry-run saw router parse backpressure on shard-11 and a few KV evictions.
priya: logs from last run:
```
[staging-router] 2024-12-02T01:02:12Z WARN backpressure_detected id=shard-11 reason=header_parse_slow
[staging-runtime] 2024-12-02T01:02:13Z INFO kv_eviction count=19 reason=header_pressure
```
olivia: rollback triggers I'd use: 5xx >0.5% sustained for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.015 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. also abort if canary p95 >500ms.
priya: I'll add temp grafana panels for `router.backpressure`, `kv_eviction_rate`, and `api.header_size_p95`. sharing link in a sec.
tom: proposed commands (will execute once we agree):
```
/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety" --by tom --until 1777774000
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-11 --type cache --by tom
```
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2024-12-03T01:45Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
infra-bot: note: increased tcp buffer on router nodes in staging for the window (temp change). rolling back after window unless told otherwise.
rachel: good catch infra-bot, thanks. priya post the grafana link and i'll draft a short QA checklist in the release doc.
priya: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/rollout/header-watch panels added. alert rule suggested: `kv_eviction_rate > 0.015 for 5m` and `router.backpressure_rate > 0.01 for 5m`.
tom: smoke with header-heavy payload now: 5xx=0.9% first pass, after a small router tweak -> 0.25%.
priya: recommend pin runtime v2.16.0 for staging window (has kernel parity fix) and keep console split FF disabled until warmup completes.
rachel: agreed. tom, please pin and place the hold. keep messages short in this thread for oncall.
tom: running `/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety"` now.
deploy-bot: hold placed by tom at 1777770088 (reason: header-split-safety)
tom: pinned runtime -> v2.16.0 for staging. prepping prewarm 18m before cutover.
deploy-bot: remember: `/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-11` to warm caches.
priya: prewarm started; ETA ~10m. will post smoke after.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted for shard-11 (id=1777770123).
priya: smoke after prewarm: 5xx 0.18%, kv_eviction_rate 0.006. screenshots uploaded to the release doc.
rachel: lift criteria: 15m stable canary with 5xx <0.2%, kv_eviction_rate <0.01, p50 <320ms. any breach -> rollback.
tom: noted. will start warmup ramp 18m before cutover. will post the release id when unhold.
infra-bot: temporary tcp buffer changes will be reverted automatically after the window. ping infra if we need extension.
olivia: thanks all. keeping eyes on the grafana panels and tracing. concise updates only here."
